step1_analysis.description: A differential circuit consisting of two inverters (XM15/17 and XM12/16) and a cross-coupled PMOS pair (XM14/13). The cross-coupled pair provides positive feedback to increase the gain and reduce transition times, commonly used as a delay cell in a ring oscillator (VCO) for a PLL or as a bistable latch.

paper_reference.title: A Self-Calibrating NFC SoC with a Triple-Mode Reconfigurable PLL and a Single-Path PICC-PCD Receiver in 0.11µm CMOS

dc_power.description: DC power consumption of the cell at the metastable point (inputs at VDD/2)

sky130_expected.calculation: Power = I(VDD) * 1.8V. With W=5u, L=0.5u, both NMOS and PMOS are ON at VDD/2. Current is roughly 100uA per branch.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Adjusted for SKY130 1.8V supply and the specific W/L dimensions provided in the netlist.

sky130_expected.calculation: Gain = gm * Rout. The cross-coupled PMOS provides negative resistance (-2/gm_p) which increases the effective Rout, boosting the gain.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Matches the paper's reported 24dB gain, which is typical for a cross-coupled delay cell stage.

sky130_expected.calculation: BW = 1 / (2 * pi * Rout * Cout). Assuming Cout ~ 20fF (parasitics + 10fF load).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Must be wide enough to support the 13.56MHz NFC carrier and its harmonics for the PLL.

prop_delay.description: Propagation delay from input crossing VDD/2 to output crossing VDD/2

sky130_expected.calculation: td = (Cout * Vswing) / I_drive. With 10fF load, 1.8V swing, and ~200uA peak drive current.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Typical delay for a 130nm ring oscillator stage to achieve frequencies in the tens to hundreds of MHz.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, AC differential gain, bandwidth, and transient propagation delay. The cross-coupled PMOS drains (N0, N2) are tied to the inverter outputs (N1, N3) to complete the latch/delay cell structure.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Differential Delay Cell / Latch Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* Parameters
.param W_xm15=5u L_xm15=0.5u
.param W_xm17=5u L_xm17=0.5u
.param W_xm14=5u L_xm14=0.5u
.param W_xm13=5u L_xm13=0.5u
.param W_xm16=5u L_xm16=0.5u
.param W_xm12=5u L_xm12=0.5u

* DUT
XM15 N1 N7 N6 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm15} w={W_xm15}
XM17 N1 N7 N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm17} w={W_xm17}
XM14 N0 N2 N6 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm14} w={W_xm14}
XM13 N2 N0 N6 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm13} w={W_xm13}
XM16 N3 N5 N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm16} w={W_xm16}
XM12 N3 N5 N6 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm12} w={W_xm12}

* Power Supplies
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VGND GND 0 0
V_N6 N6 0 1.8
V_N4 N4 0 0

* Tie cross-coupled PMOS drains to inverter outputs
V_tie1 N0 N1 0
V_tie2 N2 N3 0

* Inputs (DC=0.9V for AC symmetry, Pulse for Tran)
V_in_plus N7 0 dc 0.9 ac 0.5 pulse(0 1.8 1n 0.1n 0.1n 4n 10n)
V_in_minus N5 0 dc 0.9 ac -0.5 pulse(1.8 0 1n 0.1n 0.1n 4n 10n)

* Load Capacitors
C1 N1 0 10f
C2 N3 0 10f

.control
  * 1. DC Operating Point
  op
  let power = -i(V_N6) * 1.8
  print power

  * 2. AC Analysis
  ac dec 100 1Meg 10G
  let vout_diff = v(N3) - v(N1)
  let gain_db = 20 * log10(mag(vout_diff))
  meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=1Meg
  let gain_3db = dc_gain - 3
  meas ac bandwidth when gain_db=gain_3db fall=1

  * 3. Transient Analysis
  tran 10p 10n
  * Measure propagation delay (N5 falling -> N3 rising)
  meas tran prop_delay trig v(N5) val=0.9 fall=1 targ v(N3) val=0.9 rise=1
  * Measure rise time (20% to 80% of 1.8V)
  meas tran rise_time trig v(N3) val=0.36 rise=1 targ v(N3) val=1.44 rise=1
  
  quit
.endc
